# Scene API

<div class="doc-meta"><span class="doc-badge">Reference</span> Generated from <code>src/caffeine/script/api/scene.json</code></div>

Switching between scenes. A request is deferred: the world is replaced after the current frame's scripts finish, so call it freely from any hook. The runtime app handles requests; other hosts may not. A scene change removes every entity, so keep data you need in `caffeine.session`.

<!-- Generated by caffeine-website/scripts/generate-api-pages.py. Edit the engine JSON instead. -->

## Functions

### `caffeine.scene.load`

`load(path)`

Asks the host to load a scene, replacing the current one. A missing or unreadable file is reported and the current scene stays.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | Scene file, relative to the project root or absolute. |

**Example**

```lua
if caffeine.session.get("coins") >= 10 then caffeine.scene.load("scenes/win.scene") end
```

### `caffeine.scene.reload`

`reload()`

Reloads the current scene from disk, resetting it to its saved state.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.scene.reload() -- restart the level
```

### `caffeine.scene.current`

`current() -> string`

Returns the loaded scene.

**Returns:** `string` — The path of the loaded scene as given to the host (empty when unknown).

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.debug.log(caffeine.scene.current())
```

### `caffeine.scene.isLoading`

`isLoading() -> boolean`

Tells whether a scene change is waiting to happen.

**Returns:** `boolean` — true after load or reload was requested and before the host handled it.

**Example**

```lua
if caffeine.scene.isLoading() then return end
```
